==Description==
The '''Retro Lighthouse''' is a {{Color|Normal}} [[Maps|map]] made by Ahcerz, set on a winter island in the middle of the ocean.

==Design & Path==
The '''Retro Lighthouse''' takes place on an island completely covered in snow, which is located in the middle of the ocean. The island itself has little on it, only some trees and cliffs being scattered around it. On one part of the map, a functional lighthouse can be seen, which has a beam of light on top.

==Interactive Map==
{{Map:Retro Lighthouse}}

==Rewards==
The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}}, {{Gem|Gems}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive. Regular {{Exp|}} boosts are multiplicative with other modifiers present on this map.

Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal.

{{Rewards|Normal|Hardcore = Hide|Voidcore = Hide}}

==Strategy==
*The two u-turns around the beginning of the map are the best spots for towers, though one of them has a large area obstructed for ground towers by a cliff.
